subqueries.t: SELECT id, device, org, sec, qty, SUM(qty) OVER w AS rolling FROM events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY sec ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

field_roles.id: 行标识；最外层 ORDER BY id DESC 只控制展示顺序，与内层并列排序无关
field_roles.device: 内层 w 的 PARTITION BY 键
field_roles.org: 外层 w 的 PARTITION BY 键（本样本中全部相同）
field_roles.sec: 两层窗口共用的 ORDER BY 键（内层 ROWS、外层 RANGE）
field_roles.rolling: 内层输出别名 = SUM(qty) OVER 内层 w；同时是外层 SUM 的度量
field_roles.rolling_total: 外层输出别名 = SUM(rolling) OVER 外层 w
field_roles.w: 两层各自命名的窗口，同名但作用域互不覆盖

single_row_variant.note: WHERE id = 1 在最外层，过滤发生在两层窗口计算之后
